description: This file defines the JsonDynamicObject class, a sealed class that extends JsonDynamicBase, providing dynamic access and manipulation of JSON objects using System.Text.Json. It includes methods for getting, setting, merging, and removing JSON properties, as well as dynamic member support.

classes.name: JsonDynamicObject
classes.description: A dynamic wrapper around JsonObject enabling property access, modification, and dynamic member invocation for JSON data.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Merges the provided JsonNode content into the internal JsonObject with optional merge settings.

methods.name: TryGetMember
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a member dynamically by name, with special handling for certain member names.

methods.name: TrySetMember
methods.description: Sets a member dynamically by name.

methods.name: TryInvokeMember
methods.description: Invokes a method on the internal JsonObject dynamically.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a property by key from the JSON object.

methods.name: SelectNode
methods.description: Selects a JSON node based on a specified path.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value by key, wrapping it in appropriate dynamic types if necessary.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets a value for a key, converting it to JsonNode types as needed.

methods.name: GetDynamicMemberNames
methods.description: Returns the list of member names for debugging purposes.
